title: 4chan whistleblower: underwater mobile construction units building UAP
place_text: ocean floor near the Bahamas / Bermuda Triangle

tellings.quote: that his job was to they were monitoring these underground or underwater what they called mobile construction units, these massive,

plain: Chris Ramsay, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, retells a 2023 post by an anonymous self-described whistleblower on 4chan, an online message board. According to Ramsay, the poster said his job was to monitor huge underwater machines, called mobile construction units, on the sea floor near the Bahamas and the Bermuda Triangle, which he said were building unidentified craft (UAP, the government's term for UFOs). If true, it would mean something is manufacturing these objects under our oceans.
